title: Concatenation of Recorded Runs
statement: Let $R$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with distinguished states $yes$ and $no$, and fix a base head position for each work tape and a radius. If a run from configuration $a$ reaches $b$ in $t$ steps, avoids both distinguished states at every time before $t$, and keeps every work-tape head within the specified radius of its base position through time $t$, and a run from $b$ reaches $c$ in $v$ steps with the same avoidance and head-position bounds, then the run from $a$ reaches $c$ in $t+v$ steps, avoids both distinguished states before that time, and satisfies the same head-position bounds throughout.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-tape machine $R$ and distinguished states $yes,no$
A base integer position for each work tape and a natural-number radius
The run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps
Neither distinguished state occurs at any time $u<t$ in the first run
Every work-tape head stays within the radius of its base position for all $u\le t$ in the first run
The run from $b$ reaches $c$ after $v$ steps
Neither distinguished state occurs at any time $u<v$ in the second run
Every work-tape head stays within the radius of its base position for all $u\le v$ in the second run
